text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen is almost here, but for
the time
being, rest is what's most
necessary.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've decided to incorporate a break into
our
schedule since going too hard can
be detrimental.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grrrowl...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cheerful music is playing in the streets
and there's
holiday joy in the air.
choice_data_list: ご飯でも食べに行くか……
ご飯でも食べに行こうかな……

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
What a coincidence. Are you by yourself
too?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I'm just walking around.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
But I think I ran into you at the perfect
time,
actually. What are you doing after
this?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I see. I think I'll join you.
choice_data_list: ご飯を食べに来たんだ

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: You could say that.
choice_data_list: まだ昼ごはん食べてなかったのか？
まだ昼ごはん食べてなかったの？

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I want meat. I'll leave the place to you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, I end up sharing a meal with
Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Nice choice. The meat's top quality.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Oh, you want them? Here.
choice_data_list: まだお皿に野菜が残ってるけど……

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Without any hesitation, Narita Brian
hands me her
plate.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'll just wait till you're done. So, what's
next?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Don't you plan on going anywhere
else?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
My plan is... just to relax. I don't really
have
anything else to do.
choice_data_list: ブライアンの予定はないのか？
ブライアンの予定はないの？

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It's the last break before the Arima. I
can't afford
to injure myself or anything.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Plus, I'd rather spend time with you than
by
myself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
At least with you, we can talk about
racing, so I
can still have a productive
break. Right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Nah, it doesn't.
choice_data_list: それじゃあ意味がないよ

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Talking about racing with you is when I
feel most
relaxed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We speak a while more, and by the time
we leave
the restaurant, it's already dark
outside.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Look at all these lights. The whole
world seems
to be in the holiday spirit.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: That's our life.
choice_data_list: 俺たちはいつも通りレース一色になったけど
私たちはいつも通りレース一色になったけど

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Just because it's a holiday doesn't mean
we have
to do anything special.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You're here, I'm here, so let's just think
about
racing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Personally, I love this everyday stuff
more than
anything else.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Okay, I have a solid strategy for the
Arima. How
about we do a trial run
tonight on the academy
track?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Not even just one lap?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Stock up and then unleash, huh?
choice_data_list: 走りたい気持ちは本番にぶつけよう

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Fine. Then I'll see you at the Arima
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today turned out to be a fulfilling day
of working
toward our next goal.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: By the way...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Do you consider me a part of your
everyday life?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Heh... I see. I guess it's mutual then.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Let's get back to our everyday life
tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian smiles in satisfaction.
